connection_authentication.note: Catalog/file integrity rests on AES PKCS#7 padding and the XXTEA length word, not on an HMAC. No HMAC was traced to a connection-authentication purpose. VPN transport and connection authentication were not researched for this build.
connection_authentication.rule: The mere presence of an HMAC library or a Mac.init call confirms nothing. No key values and no hook inputs/outputs are stored in this dossier.
